role: Agentic-first programming language and compiler infrastructure for recursive self-improvement.

capabilities.name: manifest
capabilities.description: print this token-compact capability index (read this first). Effect class: pure.

capabilities.name: describe
capabilities.description: expand one manifest entry (e.g. --describe check). Effect class: pure.

capabilities.name: build=schema
capabilities.description: typed, self-describing spec interface + full error catalog (loop step 1). Effect class: pure.

capabilities.name: build=abl
capabilities.description: construct a byte-stable artifact from a spec, rejecting invalid ones (loop step 2). Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: describe=abl
capabilities.description: no-exec structured introspection of an artifact (loop step 3). Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: run=abl
capabilities.description: execute an artifact where semantics exist (loop step 4). Effect class: pure.

capabilities.name: version
capabilities.description: print the compiler version (also -V). Effect class: pure.

capabilities.name: check
capabilities.description: parse + typecheck + effect-check; structured diagnostics; no output files. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: eval
capabilities.description: run the module and print a value -- the second oracle. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: fmt-compact
capabilities.description: reformat to Agent mode (token-compact symbols). Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: fmt-expand
capabilities.description: reformat to Human mode (Rust-style keywords). Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-bytes
capabilities.description: lower Agentic Binary Language-routed items to a framed binary Agentic Binary Language container. Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: from=abl-bytes
capabilities.description: decode an Agentic Binary Language container back to a summary. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: run=abl-bytes
capabilities.description: dispatch a compiled Agentic Binary Language container through a compute backend. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-compute
capabilities.description: lower nets and run a forward pass on the compute backend. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-train
capabilities.description: find train blocks and run SGD epochs (synthetic data defaults). Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-infer
capabilities.description: load a checkpoint and run inference. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-generate
capabilities.description: autoregressive generation from a trained LM checkpoint. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl-run
capabilities.description: full pipeline: lower, train if needed, infer. Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: target=abl
capabilities.description: print the Agentic Binary Language lowering of each routed item (text form). Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: pipeline
capabilities.description: run the full self-healing compile pipeline with recovery report. Effect class: read_local.

capabilities.name: emit-ontology
capabilities.description: dump the complete system ontology as JSON. Effect class: write_local.

capabilities.name: rap
capabilities.description: serve the JSON-RPC agent protocol over TCP (default 127.0.0.1:9876). Effect class: network.

capabilities.name: (default)
capabilities.description: parse and report (token stats with --token-report). Effect class: read_local.

note: requires_grant is derived from the effect class MAGE already declares per mode under its agentic-eval taxonomy: pure and read_local need no grant, write_local and network do. That is its classification, not one applied from outside. emit-ontology is write_local and therefore shows as requiring a grant, which reads oddly for a discovery command but is correct -- it dumps the ontology to a file. That is why `ontology.command` names `--manifest` and not `--emit-ontology`: --manifest is the agent-facing 'read this first' index, effect class pure and grant-free, so discovery does not require the authority it exists to inform. --emit-ontology remains the way to obtain the complete document when writing a file is wanted. budgeted is not declared and is judged here. It marks the modes whose cost is model compute scaling with the workload rather than with the input file -- abl-train, abl-run, abl-infer, abl-generate, abl-compute -- plus rap, which serves the agent protocol over TCP for an unbounded time. Note the four modes that are budgeted but ungranted: abl-infer, abl-generate, abl-compute and, before it writes, the compute path generally. They are read_local, so they need no authority, but they can run a model for as long as the caller asks. Those are the entries where the two fields disagree on purpose -- authority and cost are different questions here, and a caller enforcing only grants would meter none of them.
